envelope.description: runAnalyze refuses a scope before it measures or announces a size

body.title: runAnalyze refuses a scope before it measures or announces a size
body.summary: src/analyze/orchestrator/driver.ts: after classification (classifier and hinted-target branches) and before measureRequestScope and the 'classified' event, the run makes the moved resolveTaskScope(intent.scopeRef, intent.target, 'the run') check (code and docs families) and ensureRepoQueryable for every non-generic source; the later check in the plan stage is removed. A refusal ends the run failed at classify with today's code and message through scopeErrorMapping and the orchestrator's classifyShaperError. The run passes scopeChecked to shaper.buildRunBundle.
acceptanceChecks: A code request on a path no registered repository contains emits no 'classified' event and no measure substep and ends failed at classify with the same code and message as today's refusal (recorded from today's code before the change); the same on the hinted-target branch and for a docs request.
A request that passes the check still emits 'classified' with its measure as before.
A request about a repository under index ends with code 'repo-indexing' (not 'internal-error'); scopeChecked reaches runShaper through ShapeOpts.

tests.name: run order: a code request on a path no registered repository contains emits no 'classified' event and no measure substep, and ends failed at classify with the same code and message as runShaper's refusal (recorded from today's code before the change)
run order: the same on the hinted-target branch
run order: a docs request on an unindexed scope emits no 'classified' event and ends failed at classify with the moved check's code and message
run order: a request that passes the check still emits 'classified' with its measure, as before
runAnalyze: a request about a repository under index ends with code 'repo-indexing' through the orchestrator's mapping (not 'internal-error')
runAnalyze's scopeChecked option reaches runShaper through ShapeOpts and does not change the cache key
